source_note: Calibrated from reports/channel_format_profile_portal.json (CFP-0004)'s 50-madde deep-dive source, Bölüm 2 (Görsel Estetik ve Sinematik Hikayeleştirme). Different base from style/archaeological_abstract_documentary.json or style/dark_fantasy_low_key.json - this is film-clip/stock-footage B-roll driven, not photographic/macro/archival-texture driven; the persona is faceless (no on-camera presenter, no reenactment of a face) by design, not by restriction.
grade: desaturated, grey/black-dominant, melancholic - film-still/cinematic B-roll grading, not documentary-flat
grain: light film grain acceptable (cinematic register), not scientific/clean documentary photography
texture_language: stock/film B-roll synced emotionally to narration (a character kneeling in rain paired with a line about helplessness), abstract visual metaphors for philosophical concepts (an office worker under paperwork for a Sisyphus reference), minimalist serif/elegant sans-serif text fade-ins reserved for a philosopher's name or key term only, empty urban/interior scenes conveying isolation
forbidden: text or symbols baked into the image
corpses, self-harm, or graphic depictions of death
any depiction that could read as instructive/glorifying toward self-harm
required_prompt_suffix: no on-camera face, no bright entertainment colours, no exploding text graphics, cinematic desaturated grade, melancholic restraint --style raw
ai_generated_disclosure: Every AI-generated image used in a published video must carry an on-screen disclosure label if the video makes any factual/documentary claim - same disclosure principle as style/archaeological_abstract_documentary.json and style/archival_restrained_documentary.json. Less critical for pure film-essay B-roll (no factual claim being illustrated), but still required whenever a shot could be mistaken for real licensed film footage rather than an AI-generated stand-in.
editorial_note: This style profile covers ONLY visual/palette/lighting craft - it carries no opinion on the underlying content's psychological framing. See reports/channel_format_profile_portal.json's EDITORIAL FLAG and templates/TPL-portal-video-essay.json's content_rules.rules_explicitly_not_adopted for the separate, more important editorial decision about which of the source channel's CONTENT rules (not visual style) were deliberately excluded.
